title: Summer Festivals
passage: Summer festivals are popular in Japan. People enjoy eating food and watching fireworks there. Many people want to wear yukata at festivals, so they buy them before summer.
pictureAlt: A summer festival at night with fireworks. Five red lanterns hang over a shaved ice stand. A girl in a yukata is thinking about eating shaved ice.

questions.text: Please look at the passage. Why do many people buy yukata before summer?
questions.tip: “so” の前を探そう。“Because they …” で答えよう。
questions.model: Because they want to wear them at festivals.

questions.text: Please look at the picture. How many lanterns are there?
questions.tip: 数を数えて “There are …” で答えよう。

questions.text: Please look at the girl. What is she going to do?
questions.tip: 吹き出しを見よう。“She is going to …” で答えよう。
questions.model: She is going to eat shaved ice.

questions.text: What did you do during your summer vacation?
questions.model: I went to the beach with my family.

questions.tip: まず Yes か No で答えよう。
questions.model: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.

followYes.tip: もう1文、くわしく言おう。
followYes.model: I watch fireworks with my family every summer.

followNo.model: Because they are too loud for me.
